_about: Page addresses, their titles and descriptions (22 Oct 2026). Read by the site server (tools/localserver: the title and description in the first HTML of each address), by deeplinks.js (the title while browsing) and by tools/site-routes/build.mjs (sitemap.xml). Edit here, then run that build. No host is named here: each copy of the site uses its own address.

default.title: Crystal Worlds
default.description: A fan-built video and game preservation project. Every Nintendo Game & Watch, and Game Boy, NES, Pokémon mini and Atari games played in the browser from your own files, with photos, manuals and each system's hardware and emulation pages.
